reasons: ADD71_STD_0001 is a single normalized 1M7 SHAPE reactivity profile with per-position REACTIVITY_ERROR; no per-replicate raw counts are stored
ADDAPO_DCP_0000 is a planning-only metadata stub (no outcome payload)
ADDRSW_SHP_0003 is the Task6 72x101 materialized SHAPE matrix; no per-replicate raw counts
observation model is clamp(normalized_reactivity, 0.01, 0.99) treated as a Bernoulli parameter; not a calibrated count likelihood
per-position error is parsed but never consumed by the clamp likelihood; per_position_error_used machine-derived to False
no independent biological construct-library-assay block crosswalk and no real marginal action cost are registered
